purpose: close Observational System V1 by sealing the admitted observer instance, its stage-qualified implementation authority, empirical ancestry, findings, and explicit insufficiencies without producing new observations
constitutional_law: record exactly what the existing observational system saw, how it saw it, where it is blind, and where it has not been evaluated

identity.implementation: a typed MT5 and Rust component bundle whose authority and parity status are declared per stage
identity.observer_instance: the exact semantically relevant composite configuration admitted by the sealed corpus
identity.corpus: the immutable RG2 and RG3 empirical branches admitted by their existing seals
identity.ancestry: a directed acyclic graph of immutable contracts, artifacts, receipts, source closures, and findings through Gate 16.5

authority_matrix.boundary: VolKitt, profile, day-swings, and Wayne raw producer outputs
authority_matrix.reason: the parity tape does not contain the raw historical producer inputs and exact warmup/state contracts required for independent C1 reconstruction

authority_matrix.boundary: normalization, compatibility, DBSCAN, nodes and lifecycle, provenance, regional state, causal frozen features, auction attempts, episodes, events, censoring, and transits
authority_matrix.reason: certified from the raw producer-output boundary

authority_matrix.boundary: compression and expansion objects, representations, atlases, distances, and representation-loss receipts
authority_matrix.reason: Rust consumes sealed MT5 observations and does not replace MT5 C1 producer authority

stagewise_matrix_law.row_identity: each row binds one stage, claim class, input boundary, MT5 role, Rust role, status, measured population, certified scope, explicit exclusion, and hashed evidence identifiers
stagewise_matrix_law.parity_lane: only C1 through D3 use the independent reconstruction parity claim class; C1 remains OPEN and C2 through D3 pass only on the bounded admitted oracle
stagewise_matrix_law.adjacent_evidence: MT5 replay determinism, model inference parity, behavioral holdout confirmation, RG3 sealing, and Gate 15 through Gate 16.5 rebuild determinism remain separately typed and cannot be aggregated into a broader implementation-parity claim

observer_scope.scope_statement: OSV1 deeply observed one composite multitimeframe configuration, not one timeframe and not the full parameterized observer family
unobserved: global clock dilation with preserved clock relationships
observer_scope.ratio_policy: timeframe ratios may be recorded only as descriptive configuration metadata; session calendars and nonuniform market time forbid physical scale interpretation

theta0_law: no parameter is admitted without a source locator and evidence class
declared inputs are distinguished from settings consumed by executable semantics
all 42 admitted RG3 runs must resolve to one recorded configuration hash
a recovered source or executable hash is not called run-bound unless an admitted run receipt contains that hash
a semantically different configuration is a different observer instance

theta0_artifact_law.required_field_contract: every field carries a typed value summary, evidence class, run-binding status, consumption status, configuration-hash membership, and one or more exact provenance locators
theta0_artifact_law.run_binding_limit: campaign INI values are CAMPAIGN_CONFIGURED; measurement-run values are RUN_RECORDED; expanded Master defaults are RECOVERED_FROM_COLLECTION_ENVIRONMENT and remain not run-bound because no admitted receipt contains the exact EX5 identity or expanded Master ConfigText
theta0_artifact_law.nonoperational_input: InpRequireFreshLineageWindow is present in every campaign INI and in the RG3 configuration hash but has no operational use outside ObjectConfigText

branches: RG3 -> Gate 14 -> Gate 15 -> Gate 15.5 -> Gate 16 -> Gate 16.5
ancestry_law.root_rule: leaf identities and registries are hashed first; the OSV1 root manifest is built after all children; the root receipt is written last
ancestry_law.evidence_rule: every ancestry node binds the exact SHA-256, declared contract, and admitted status of its machine artifact

findings_law.authority_rule: a prose-only or human-summary claim cannot become an authoritative OSV1 fact without a sealed machine artifact

findings_artifact_law.admission: only JSON artifacts whose exact SHA-256 is bound by a machine certificate, manifest, or seal receipt may produce a finding or insufficiency
findings_artifact_law.excluded_sources: Markdown, prose reports, human summaries, unsealed JSON, inferred values, and rewritten interpretations are never finding authority

source_closure_law.mt5: resolve the recursive preprocessor include closure from the RG3 collector source actually present in the collection terminal; preserve absolute external includes exactly and fail on unresolved dependencies
source_closure_law.rust: seal repository-relative local source, manifests, and lockfiles for the auction-parity and market-object workspaces; preserve registry package identities through Cargo.lock
source_closure_law.replacement_forbidden: a current repository mirror may be compared but never silently substituted for the source path selected by the admitted build
source_closure_law.logical_identity: hash canonical logical locators and file SHA-256 values in deterministic order
source_closure_law.physical_identity: record exact source locators and file SHA-256 values separately from logical identity

rebuild_law.comparison: all 17 closure artifacts are rebuilt independently and must be byte-identical to one another and to the canonical closure
rebuild_law.failure_mode: any missing artifact, byte mismatch, ancestry failure, or root receipt mismatch aborts closure

preserved_limits: C1 independent Rust producer parity remains OPEN
cross-scale object and geometry transport remain NOT_EVALUABLE
no mechanism, economic usefulness, policy, deployment, or trading authority is created
forbidden: mutation of RG2, RG3, or Gate 13R through Gate 16.5 artifacts
exit_requirements: Theta0 field census complete with evidence and consumption status
MT5 and Rust source dependency closure resolves without substitution
findings and insufficiency ledgers are deterministic
two independent closure rebuilds are byte-identical
OSV1 root manifest and receipt bind both ancestry leaves
constrained_claim: Gate 16.6 closes one admitted composite observer instance with MT5 producer authority and independently parity-verified downstream Rust reconstruction from the raw producer-output boundary. It seals the RG2 and RG3 empirical ancestry through Gate 16.5 while leaving independent C1 parity, alternative observer configurations, cross-scale transport, auction-interval conditioning, mechanism, economics, and trading authority explicitly unresolved.
